metadata.description: Philipps geprüfte Claude-Plugins. Updates werden vor der Übernahme auf Schadcode geprüft.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls

plugins.name: marketing-skills
plugins.description: Marketing skills for AI agents — conversion optimization, copywriting, SEO, paid ads, ad creative, and growth

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Security review for Claude-generated code. Pattern-based warnings on edits, LLM-powered diff review on Stop, and an agentic commit reviewer that catches injection, XSS, SSRF, hardcoded secrets, and 25+ other vulnerability classes.

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

plugins.name: swift-lsp
plugins.description: Swift language server (SourceKit-LSP) for code intelligence

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Baut auf Zuruf (/graphify) aus Code, Doku, PDFs und Bildern einen abfragbaren Wissensgraphen. Nur Skill, keine Hooks.

plugins.name: anatomy
plugins.description: Erklärt Technik als interaktive isometrische Maschine (SVG/WebGL, eine HTML-Datei). Ohne Community-Galerie-Upload.
